# JobAgent247

> JobAgent247 is an AI-powered job-search platform for UK and India job seekers. Ten specialised AI agents work together to score and rewrite your CV against any job description, find matching live jobs across 50+ UK and Indian job sites, draft tailored cover letters and recruiter messages, track applications, and prepare you for interviews. The ATS target on every generated CV is 90+.

JobAgent247 is built UK-first with India as the second market. UK jobs are sourced live from Reed, Adzuna, CV-Library, CWJobs, JobServe, and Indeed. India jobs are sourced from Naukri, Foundit, Shine, TimesJobs, and Jooble. CV scoring, rewriting, cover letter generation, and interview preparation are powered by Anthropic Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6) with prompt caching.

## Pricing

Three plans. Both UK (GBP) and India (INR) pricing are available. See [/pricing.md](https://jobagent247.co/pricing.md) for a machine-readable price list.

- **Free** — £0/mo. 3 CV analyses, 3 job matches, 2 cover letters, 1 CV rewrite. Per-feature lifetime quota.
- **Pro** — £9.99/mo or £95.88/yr (UK), $9.99/mo (US), ₹500/mo (India). Unlimited CV analyses + rewrites, 50 job matches/mo, 20 cover letters/mo, application tracker, follow-up drafts.
- **Career Accelerator** — £29.99/mo or £287.88/yr (UK), ₹1000/mo (India). Everything in Pro, plus unlimited bulk match, unlimited cover letters, DOCX/PDF export, mock interviews, multiple CV versions.

Founding-member trial: the first 100 users get 30 days of Pro free.
